cards.prompt: Retinal and retinol both belong to which family of compounds?
Why does retinal work faster than retinol?
options: It is closer to the active form, retinoic acid
It is made from vitamin C
It needs no conversion at all
cards.answer: It is closer to the active form, retinoic acid.

cards.prompt: Order these from furthest to closest to the active form of vitamin A.
cards.answer: Retinol, then retinal, then retinoic acid.

cards.prompt: Retinal gives faster results than retinol but may irritate skin more.
cards.answer: Fact: faster results, potentially more irritation.

cards.prompt: Your friend has easily irritated skin but wants the fastest results, so she picks retinal. What trade-off should you point out?
cards.answer: Retinal acts faster because it is closer to retinoic acid, but it is more likely to irritate the skin than retinol.

cards.prompt: I am the pure, active form of vitamin A. Retinal is one step from me, retinol two. What am I?
